neighbours.label: saying that something is bad or wrong (horrendous, too soft, wrong, mistakes)
fire: She received a dreadful review from her manager.
A pillow that is too hard can cause neck pain.
If the diagnosis is wrong, the treatment will not help.
The hotel was filthy and the staff were horrible.
That was an awful decision by the coach.
The tyrant ruined the country and jailed his critics.
His atrocious spelling embarrassed the whole class.

The hotel was large and the staff were young.
That was an early decision by the coach.
The mayor visited the country and thanked his hosts.
His neat spelling pleased the whole class.
